head_commit.message:
Keep local candidate validation failures semantic

Use explicit transport classification for GitHub API and remote Git operations. A worker patch rejected by actual git apply, scope validation, or size checks must consume the bounded worker evidence budget rather than retry forever as an external outage.

Verify the real create_candidate path with an authenticated malformed patch, plus bounded worker failure and remote transport recovery tests.
